products.name: Clearscope
products.note: Content optimization AI; readability scoring; competitor content analysis

profile_text.body:
Clearscope is a content optimization platform that describes itself as "the discoverability platform for a new era in search," focused on helping brands improve their visibility in both traditional search engines and AI-generated results. The company's site states that its tools cover the full content workflow, from topic research and query discovery to AI-assisted drafting and ongoing optimization, with the stated goal of improving measurable presence across Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.

The platform's core product, also called Clearscope, is categorized as a writing and editing tool that combines content optimization, readability scoring, and competitor content analysis. A feature called Query Discovery allows users to enter a topic or website URL to surface queries generating traffic and attention across multiple search and AI systems. The site also highlights AI drafting and editing capabilities intended to accelerate content production and address writer's block.

The held facts record no litigation, no MCP server presence, and no SEC or patent filings associated with the company. Clearscope does maintain a profile on theworldofai.org under a single tracked product.
